tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the mechoulam.de cannabis-medicine evidence register by free text (indication, condition, drug, study title, author). Returns indications and reviewed studies with citable URLs. Answer language follows the language of the query.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one full record by the id returned from search: the GRADE-rated evidence summary of an indication, or one study with its per-indication verdicts. Includes the source URL to cite.

tools.name: list_indications
tools.description: List all indications on mechoulam.de with slug, name, category, count of reviewed studies and the citable page URL.

tools.name: get_indication
tools.description: Get the GRADE-rated evidence summary for one indication (reviewed studies only). Use a slug from list_indications.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Get one study by DOI with its per-indication verdicts (reviewed-only).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
